answer: Unrepeatable Answer Challenge. Each identity must publish a fresh solution to a locally generated puzzle; the reply is checked against all prior answers, and any exact repeat is rejected. Answers are stored along a public hash ridge, so duplicates collapse instantly. Attackers must solve every puzzle independently, paying compute per identity plus a sable penalty bond forfeited on repetition, which makes mass fabrication cost scale linearly while a shared answer cannot bridge two identities.
